svg.text: Media Upload Architecture — The Journey Association
Requires: php artisan storage:link (symlink public/storage → storage/app/public)
✓ DB row in media_assets table (id, file_url, file_type, alt_text, uploaded_by)
Used by: MediaLibrary, ImageUpload (clubs/events), CMS media picker
Vite Static / Laravel Public — NO DB tracking
→ club upload | URL: /uploads/clubs/{id}.{ext} | served by Vite
How public pages resolve a media ID or URL at render time
if url starts with /storage/ → prepend API base URL
if url starts with /uploads/ → prepend API base URL
if url starts with http → use as-is (already absolute)
API base: https://api.thejourney-ma.org (prod) or empty (dev via proxy)
3. Pass url through resolveStorageUrl() to get full absolute URL
4. Rendered in or background-image: url()
Used by: PresidentMessage, HeroSection, NavbarLogo, AboutSection…
No explicit size limit in code
Static file only — no DB row
SVG / club upload — no DB row
1. storage:link must be run on each fresh server: php artisan storage:link — without it /storage/* URLs return 404.
2. Uploads to public/uploads/** (hero, navbar, clubs) are NOT in media_assets — they cannot be selected in MediaPickerDialog or managed from MediaLibrary.
3. resolveStorageUrl() prepends api.thejourney-ma.org in production; in dev the Vite proxy transparently rewrites /storage/* → Laravel, so relative paths work.
